736:t_2:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Come... Now is the time for us to become one.」

736:t_2:8.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「W-what are you talking about!?」

736:t_2:9.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「D-don't tell me...! You did to $$サクリファイ$$... just as they said...!」

736:t_2:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is the only way to save the universe.」

736:t_2:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Can you stop the universe's great collapse!?」

736:t_2:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「There is no need to do that.」

736:t_2:14.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The universe must be reborn.」

736:t_2:15.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「What are you saying, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!?」

736:t_2:16.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Let us become one, $$ドクトリン$$, $$テンプティ$$. You will become eternal within me.」

736:t_2:17.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Th-that means... $$テンプティ$$ will disappear!」

736:t_2:18.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「There is no need to fear. Your soul will live within me.」

736:t_2:19.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「N-no! Stay away! Don't come near me!」

736:t_2:20.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Why, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!? Weren't we eternal beings who had transcended lies and conflict!?」

736:t_2:21.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Let us dispense with empty, pleasant words, $$ドクトリン$$. You committed the grave sin of banishing me.」

736:t_2:22.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That was when I understood. Even the $$御使い$$s were not enough to save the universe.」

736:t_2:23.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I returned and tested whether you were worthy of saving the universe. The result was disappointing.」

736:t_2:25.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Disappointing... You mean we failed!?」

736:t_2:26.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is why we will become one... to bring about the Supreme God's rebirth too.」

736:t_2:27.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Rebirth!? You've only gathered eight $$スフィア$$s!」

736:t_2:28.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Without all the $$スフィア$$s, the Supreme God will...!」

736:t_2:29.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Your failure to address that was negligence. I spent twelve thousand years seeking a way to overcome it.」

736:t_2:30.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You three and $$アサキム$$ will make up for the four missing $$スフィア$$s.」

736:t_2:32.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「For that, I needed your power taken away, even temporarily. They fulfilled that vital role admirably.」

736:t_2:34.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Yes... I have guided $c for this day.」

736:t_2:35.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「And I will become the Supreme God itself and save the reborn universe.」

736:t_2:36.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「I-I'm sorry! I'm sorry, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Forgive us for what happened twelve thousand years ago!」

736:t_2:37.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Have mercy on us, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

736:t_2:38.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「God does not permit that.」

736:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Well, we narrowly escaped, but even I do not know what will happen next.」

736:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The one thing I can say for certain is that the next battle will truly be the final showdown.」

736:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I, $$ＡＧ$$, will never forget the days I spent fighting alongside you all...」

736:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「These 2000 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s embody those feelings... I will add them to the squad's stock, so please use them to your heart's content.」

736:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then... This is the last $$Ｄトレーダー$$. We will go all out, as befits a final sale!」

736:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll keep my spirits up to the very end... Business, business!」

737:t_000:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「This is the equivalent of where $$ラース・バビロン$$ stood on our Earth.」

737:t_000:2.en:
$$桂$$
「I can feel it... the presence of something incredibly dangerous...」

737:t_001:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I sense overwhelming power worthy of that name.」

737:t_001:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes... The sun of this $$カオス・コスモス$$ must have been transformed into that $$黒い太陽#sol$$.」

737:t_001:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Stars are masses of $$次元力|lc$$...」

737:t_001:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If Earth is a place that gathers power from particularly powerful stars in the universe, then naturally the same goes for its sun.」

737:t_001:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then it's like a device the $$御使い$$s use to draw out $$次元力|lc$$...!」

737:t_002:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It is just as you sense. That is what will become the new Supreme God.」

737:t_002:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I have been waiting for you.」

737:t_003:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「So you've come out, you damn servants!」

737:t_003:1.en:
$$葵$$
「You're holding nothing back for the final battle, huh!」

737:t_003:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Do not assume this is the extent of our full strength.」

737:t_003:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Though some of our forces have been dispatched to the other universes.」

737:t_003:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「Are they there to destroy humanity as it tries to evolve!?」

737:t_003:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「No. They are there to stop the universe's great collapse.」

737:t_003:7.en:
$$刹那$$
「What do you mean, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!?」

737:t_003:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You have no need to know that. Now, let us begin.」

737:t_003:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(Is he growing anxious? He is in a strange hurry for him...)

737:t_003:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「If you're ready to fight, then we'll...!」

737:t_003:11.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$... It seems there is no other way for things to end between us.」

737:t_003:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It is a shame. I did love you all.」

737:t_003:14.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'll strike you down for $$アサキム$$ and $$サクリファイ$$ too!」

737:t_003:15.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Chief! I'm counting on you to handle the rest!」

737:t_003:16.en:
$n
「I'll settle this, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, for Dad, Mom, and Sis... and for myself!」

737:t_003:18.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is fine, $n. I have put you through trials for this very day.」

737:t_003:19.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But you will end here! Feel the power of an $$御使い$$ who holds eight $$スフィア$$s!」

737:t_004:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Impossible...! $$ヘリオース$$ and I...!」

737:t_004:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I have gathered eight $$スフィア$$s! And yet...!」

737:t_004:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「Roger! Leave the rest to me!」
